Bee Choo Origin: Signature Herbal Treatment 4.9/5 Stars on Google!

See All Photos

Recently recognised at the Daily Vanity Beauty Treatment Awards 2026 as a Readers’ Choice winner, the Bee Choo Origin Signature Herbal Treatment is designed to support a healthier scalp while addressing concerns such as hair fall, excess sebum and buildup.

The treatment is formulated with 16 herbal ingredients, including TCM botanicals such as Ginseng, Dang Gui, Ling Zhi and He Shou Wu, which are traditionally used to nourish the scalp and hair roots. It is available in both Coloured and Colourless options.

The Coloured version naturally stains grey or white hair a reddish-copper tone, while the Colourless option focuses on scalp care without changing the hair shade. A Darken Treatment is also available for those who prefer a deeper finish.

TrichoLab: Hair Vitality Treatment  4.9/5 Stars on Google!

TrichoLab takes a more science-led approach to hair and scalp care, with treatments tailored to concerns ranging from hair loss and oily scalps to damaged lengths.

For those dealing with thinning hair, its Hair Vitality Treatment combines deep scalp cleansing, a nourishing hair-growth serum, galvanic treatment and red-light LED therapy to support a healthier scalp environment.

For damaged or unruly strands, the TrichoSmooth Hair Treatment is another option, using a formaldehyde-free formula to hydrate, strengthen and smooth the hair. TrichoSmooth is also designed for coloured, bleached and chemically treated hair.

Hairstuff: Epres Treatment & Shiseido Shielding Programme 5/5 Stars on Google!

ADVERTISEMENT

If humidity has turned your hair into a frizzy, unruly mess, Hairstuff offers treatments designed around improving manageability and hair condition.

Its Epres Treatment focuses on hair repair, using repair science to help strengthen weakened strands, while the Shiseido Shielding Programme forms a hydrophobic coating over the hair surface to help protect it from external damage.

There’s also the Shiseido Salon Solution, which targets calcium buildup inside the hair shaft and helps improve the condition of damaged hair. With options spanning repair, hydration and volume, the salon caters to different hair concerns rather than taking a one-treatment-fits-all approach.

V Aesthetics Hair Grow: V Magic Hair Grow  4.9/5 Stars on Google!

Hair fall and thinning require a different approach from treating dry or frizzy strands, which is where V Aesthetics Hair Grow comes in.

Its V Magic Hair Grow is a five-step treatment that begins with scalp and hair analysis before moving on to scalp detox and wash, DEP hair and scalp infusion, a signature hair-growth tonic and LED therapy.

The treatment is designed for concerns including thinning hair, patterned hair loss and patchy hair loss. The centre says its DEP technology is designed to enhance the absorption of active ingredients without needles, making this an option for those looking for a non-surgical approach.

FAQ: Hair Treatment In Singapore — What You Need To Know

What is the best hair treatment in Singapore?

The best hair treatment in Singapore depends on your main concern. Scalp-focused treatments may be more suitable for hair fall, oily scalp and buildup, while repair, smoothing and hydration treatments are better suited for frizz, dryness and damaged lengths.

Which hair treatment is best for hair fall in Singapore?

For hair fall, look for treatments that focus on the scalp and hair roots rather than treatments designed mainly to smooth or repair the hair lengths. Options such as Bee Choo Origin, TrichoLab and V Aesthetics Hair Grow offer scalp-focused treatments for different hair-loss concerns.

What is the best treatment for frizzy hair in Singapore?

Treatments that focus on hydration, smoothing and strengthening can help improve the appearance and manageability of frizzy hair. Hairstuff, TrichoLab and Jo:Hwa Hair & Living offer treatments aimed at smoothing, repairing or managing unruly hair.

Are hair treatments in Singapore suitable for coloured or bleached hair?

Yes. Some treatments are specifically formulated for coloured, bleached or chemically treated hair. For example, TrichoLab’s TrichoSmooth and Hairstuff’s Shiseido treatments are options for hair that has undergone chemical processing.

How often should I get a hair treatment?

The ideal frequency depends on your hair and scalp condition and the type of treatment. Scalp-focused treatments may be recommended regularly for ongoing concerns, while intensive repair or smoothing treatments may be needed less frequently.

How much does a hair treatment cost in Singapore?

Hair treatment prices in Singapore vary depending on the salon, treatment type, hair length and whether the service focuses on the scalp or hair. It is best to check the latest pricing directly with the salon before booking, as prices and promotions can change.

What is the difference between a scalp treatment and a hair treatment?

A scalp treatment focuses primarily on the scalp, addressing concerns such as excess oil, buildup and scalp discomfort. A hair treatment focuses more on the hair lengths, helping with concerns such as dryness, frizz, damage, weakness and lack of shine.

Can hair treatments help with oily scalp and buildup?

Scalp-focused treatments can help cleanse the scalp and remove excess oil and buildup, depending on the treatment. If your scalp is consistently oily or uncomfortable, a professional scalp assessment can help identify a suitable treatment.

What should I consider before choosing a hair treatment in Singapore?

Start by identifying your main concern: hair fall, oily scalp, dryness, frizz, damage or lack of volume. You should also consider whether your hair is coloured or chemically treated, as some treatments are specifically designed for certain hair conditions.

Where can I get a hair treatment in Singapore?

There are many hair treatment salons and scalp-care centres across Singapore. Options featured in this guide include Bee Choo Origin, TrichoLab, Hairstuff, V Aesthetics Hair Grow, PHS HAIRSCIENCE and Jo:Hwa Hair & Living.

Is a hair treatment or haircut better for damaged hair?

A haircut removes visibly damaged ends, while a hair treatment focuses on improving the condition and appearance of the existing hair. For significantly damaged hair, combining regular trims with an appropriate repair treatment may be more useful than relying on either one alone.

What hair treatment is good for dry and damaged hair?

Look for treatments that focus on hydration, strengthening and repair. Options such as Hairstuff’s Epres Treatment, TrichoLab’s TrichoSmooth and Jo:Hwa Hair & Living’s bespoke treatments are designed around improving the condition of damaged or dry hair.

How do I know which hair treatment is right for my hair type?

Your hair type is only one factor. Your main concern, scalp condition, hair history and whether your hair has been coloured or chemically treated can all affect which treatment is most suitable. When in doubt, ask for a scalp or hair assessment before booking.
